# Phase Template

## Status

Not started.

## Objective

State the measurable business and engineering outcome.

## Entry Requirements

List predecessor exits, approvals, and required inputs.

## Scope

List included capabilities and boundaries.

## Explicit Exclusions

List what must not be added in this phase.

## Required Software and Services

List approved technologies, tools, dependencies, and environments.

## Security and Data Requirements

List authorization, privacy, audit, retention, and failure rules.

## Deliverables

List code, migrations, APIs, UI, documentation, infrastructure, and operational outputs.

## Verification

List unit, integration, permission, migration, worker, browser, security, and recovery checks.

## Exit Criteria

List objective completion conditions.

## Stop Conditions

List conditions that block progression.
